items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: One day in Chicago, the word got out that Freddy Kephard played... everybody went up there, all the musicians would go up to hear Freddy Kephard

ctx.x: That's a true story. One day in Chicago, the word got out that Freddy Kephard played -- was playing and he blew a note so loud that he -- that the straight mute that he was playing jumped clean out of his horn, went all away across the night club floor. He hit this note, and so naturally everybody went up there, all the musicians would go up to hear Freddy Kephard, to see him do it again. But he never did it again.
Did you ever talk to anyone who was there a -- that night?
